response_en:
We strictly accept PayMaya (Maya) and GCash ONLY!
  1. Maya / InstaPay QR: Scan our official Maya QR code under the name WILLY GAILO (@willygailojr) using the Maya app or GCash app (Scan QR / QR Ph).
  2. GCash Express: You can also send payment directly to GCash: 0912 345 6789.
  3. Copy the Transaction Reference Number and take a screenshot of your receipt.
  4. Go to your User Dashboard → My Bookings → click Pay and upload your proof of payment.
Our frontdesk and administration will verify your receipt promptly!

response_tl:
Napakadali mag-book ng kwarto sa Marvelous Hotel!
  1. Pumunta sa Browse Rooms o mag-login sa inyong User Account.
  2. Piliin ang nais na kwarto o dormitory bed at itakda ang Check-in at Check-out dates.
  3. I-click ang Book Now / Confirm Booking.
  4. Magbayad gamit ang GCash o PayMaya at i-upload ang inyong resibo sa dashboard.
response_en:
Booking a room at Marvelous Hotel is very easy!
  1. Navigate to Browse Rooms or log in to your User Account.
  2. Select your preferred room type or dormitory bed and specify your Check-in and Check-out dates.
  3. Click Book Now / Confirm Booking.
  4. Pay via GCash or PayMaya and upload your screenshot receipt in the dashboard.

response_en: All rooms and dormitories come with complimentary high-speed Fiber WiFi (up to 200 Mbps) for all guests.
